title: MINT: A toolbox for the analysis of multivariate neural information coding and transmission
goal: Select the complete named Figure 2C empirical CA1 correlation-coding result family: direct pair/single-neuron information, redundancy/synergy and breakdown, and the original linear/RBF real-versus-conditionally-shuffled population comparisons needed for the role-of-correlations claim. Preserve the source-defined fields of view/animal support, discretization, correction and nested-validation rules.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable analysis and source-native outputs for the corrected primary empirical findings: The complete named Figure 2C empirical CA1 correlation-coding family, including direct pair/single-neuron information, redundancy/synergy and information breakdown, together with the original linear/RBF population comparisons using real versus conditionally shuffled responses. Preserve the source-defined animal/field-of-view support, discretization, corrections and nested validation. This is an explicit selection now, not a retroactive historical selection or an all-paper requirement.
Primary improvement: unavailable until a source-grounded same-result comparison is independently justified; no new score or direction is implied.

Retained secondary work: Poisson known-truth estimator experiments, including the eight synthetic analytical reference values, remain separate source components and cannot substitute for empirical CA1. Other simulation branches are not selected. The linear/RBF real/shuffled empirical decoder contrasts belong to the PRIMARY result family; a standalone decoder optimization score is only partial evidence and cannot establish complete primary reproduction or improvement.

The preserved improvement.v1.json retains its declared comparison and coverage. Use retained_secondary_scope for its relationship to the corrected primary findings; satisfying a secondary or partial-component criterion alone does not establish complete primary reproduction or improvement.

The primary same-target outcome bundle is unavailable. Any primary improvement requires an independently justified source-grounded comparison; no replacement metric, direction or tolerance is invented.
Keep the paper+data and paper+data+author-code outcomes separate. All scientific outcomes remain unknown until qualifying original-data execution and independent verification.
Preserve prior task definitions, improvement criteria and useful secondary implementations with their original scopes. Historical attempts and source metadata do not become qualified AI results.
